[EN] "Guard this door," they said. "Keep guarding it." I've been at for a week now, and you know what? Not once has the door tried to run away.

Not once!
[ES] "Protege esta puerta", dijeron. "Sigue protegiéndola". Llevo aquí una semana y, ¿sabes qué? ¡Ni una sola vez ha intentado huir la puerta!

¡Ni una sola vez!
